description: Source code for a checkpoint server handling Hibernate and Wakeup processes via socket communication, including connection setup, message sending/receiving, and process control functions.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a server, supporting Unix domain or TCP sockets based on the server locator.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command over a socket and receives a response, handling connection setup and timeout.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a checkpoint (hibernate) process for a given PID with a specified timeout.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up a process identified by PID, with handling for invalid PIDs and timeouts.
